name: Furniture XIAING
summary: Warm, moody slow-furniture store with dim interior photography, a sans headline broken by one serif italic phrase, and sticky full-bleed room scenes carrying shoppable product cards.

signature: hero headline in white grotesk with one phrase swapped to a grey serif italic
three stacked sticky full-screen room scenes, each with a numbered label, rust tag chip and a glassy product card bottom right
category cards in a staggered stair-step row with a notched white label tab cut into the bottom corner
imagery: dim, warm, AI-staged interiors and terraces at dusk, soft studio shots of timber pieces on cream walls
